Object Info

In the course of writing Smoothinator I once again came up hard against gaps in the documentation and the functionality of Martin's Parameter Info script, and remembered I had long ago written (and lost) an improved version. Here is a new macro script called Object Info that creates nicely formatted "documentation" for a selected object, renders it in markdown, and tries to open the file.

http://loewald.com/c3dbook/Scripts/Object-Info/

Links: http://loewald.com/c3dbook/Scripts/Object-Info/
